title: Agent round contract
description: One reconstructed agent batch. Each JSONL line in agent-rounds.jsonl validates against this schema. A batch may aggregate adjacent assistant messages and tool calls only when source IDs establish that they belong to the same turn/batch.

schema.description: Round contract discriminator. Both historical round.v1 and current agent-round.v1 are accepted.

id.description: Canonical round ID in the consolidated Tura form.

roundId.description: Canonical round ID in the detailed provider reconstruction form.

index.description: One-based round index in consolidated form.

roundIndex.description: One-based round index in detailed form.

title.description: Short display title such as Agent round 3.

intent.description: Source/reconstruction intent used to explain how this batch was formed.

startedAt.description: Round start time when a trustworthy event exists.

endedAt.description: Round end time when a trustworthy event exists.

batch.description: Evidence that multiple source events were merged into one displayed batch.

sourceRoundIds.description: Ordered source round/turn IDs included in the batch.

certainty.description: Grouping evidence label. Values such as exact, inferred, or collector-same-round must be explained by the producer.

input.description: Input context sent into this round when preserved.

messages.description: Input messages attributable to this boundary.

fullContext.description: Complete recovered context. Empty when the provider log did not expose it.

output.description: Complete assistant output for this round.

fullOutput.description: Complete serialized output for archival inspection.

assistantMessage.description: Complete assistant-authored message with Markdown and line breaks preserved.

messages.description: Display-order user/assistant/system messages for the batch.

commands.description: Commands and tool calls belonging to the same verified batch.

toolCalls.description: Detailed-form alias for complete tool calls.

usage.description: Per-round usage only when directly supported by source data. Null members are accepted for archived rounds and must not be rendered as numeric values.

providerDurationMs.description: Provider request duration attributable to this round.

sources.description: Relative artifact paths used to reconstruct this round.

providerLogPath.description: Original provider log path when retained.

metadata.description: Source IDs, model facts, grouping evidence, and reconstruction provenance. Custom fields are allowed here.
